messages.subject: quantiles and time series in ggplot2
parts:
Hi

I am new to ggplot 2 and I have some questions.
I hope you can help me out

how can I plot quantiles that were previously calculated, with ggplot2?

X=runif(34,min=4, max=89)

quantiles.X=quantile(dataset,probs=c(.01,.03,.05,.1,.15,.20,.50,.70,.80,.90,.95))
> quantiles.X
1% 3% 5% 10% 15% 20%
50% 70% 80% 90% 95%

5.292614 5.813105 9.509620 20.036279 25.542286 28.704292
49.796086 68.832996 76.725968 77.947276 80.549077

I wanted to plot the quantiles similar to this
http://i.stack.imgur.com/V6xze.png


How can I overlay in the same ggplot2, 2 time series with the same length?

time series 1 (dataset1)

Date Obs
2192 1976-01-01 1.2
2193 1976-01-02 3.5
2194 1976-01-03 2.6
2195 1976-01-04 7.8
2196 1976-01-05 1.0
2197 1976-01-06 0


time series 2 (dataset2)

Date Obs
2192 1980-01-01 0.2
2193 1980-01-02 1.3
2194 1980-01-03 2.0
2195 1980-01-04 8.0
2196 1980-01-05 2.5
2197 1980-01-06 0.6


for one time series I am using this code

qplot(main="Observations for Stations 1")+xlab("Years")+ylab("Daily
Observations")+
geom_point(data = dataset1,aes(Date, Obs, colour="green"))+
scale_colour_identity("Legend", breaks=c("green"), labels="Station1")

and i would like to overlay the plot with another time series for the
same Station for a different year, like this one
http://www.ec.gc.ca/natchem/A566D8F8-07C7-40BB-BDE7-03BE6FE21A7F/1_CAPM_overlay_plot.jpg
